en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing an industrial landscape with several factory buildings and tall chimneys in a flat rural area. In the foreground are open fields; in the background an extensive complex of industrial works stretches across the horizon. The lower part of the card is left blank for writing and contains printed captions in German, including the locality name and publisher details.
